I once scored an own goal for Preston North End, only to score my first senior goal a minute later.
Following my time at Brighton, I joined my boyhood club where I scored in the 2025 EFL Cup final.
I've played with the likes of Mac Allister, Isak & Gordon.

style.why: The hook (own goal followed immediately by a first senior goal) is memorable and charming, fitting the 'delightful oddity' criteria well. The structure follows the house style with connected sentences ('Following my time at...') and a narrowing clue list of teammates from different clubs/stages (Mac
style.fix: Allister, Isak & Gordon). It reads naturally and avoids dull procedural details. It loses one point because the final sentence is slightly generic in its phrasing compared to the more evocative originals, but it remains strong.
